mrxcat.license_summary: MRXCAT_mri/README.md grants non-commercial research use and asks users to cite the MRXCAT publication; no separate SPDX license file is tracked.
notes: The repository includes generated XCAT tissue VTI examples; XCAT is still required if a new background/anatomy is generated rather than using the supplied example.

mesh_primary_myocardium.blood_pool: coarse supplied XCAT VTI nearest-neighbour resample (surrounding nuisance only)

timing_selection.selection_rule: coordinate median reference; MAD robust scaling; nearest actual observed group

acquisition_time_ms.derivation: selected timing9 + TR*VPS + original HHZ TI/T2prep intervals

sax.selection_rule: modal group count/shape/spacing/thickness; orientation retained from lexicographic-source tie-break

2ch.selection_rule: modal group count/shape/spacing/thickness; orientation retained from lexicographic-source tie-break

4ch.selection_rule: modal group count/shape/spacing/thickness; orientation retained from lexicographic-source tie-break

spatial_integration.rule: midpoint quadrature in signal space; linear signal interpolation
